browse.migrationRequired: {{name}} changed its entry addresses; library entries need migration
browse.migrationRequiredMany: {{names}} changed their entry addresses; library entries need migration
browse.localHint: Read manga directly from directories on the server. Every path must exist; they can also be changed later in the source's settings.
browse.opdsHint: OPDS 1.2 catalogs of self-hosted servers like Komga / Kavita / Calibre-Web; credentials are only used for reading.
browse.missingFromRepos: This source is no longer in any configured source repo, so it will not receive updates and may stop working in the future
browse.deleteHint: This removes the source, its library entries and reading progress. Downloaded files on the server are kept.
browse.trashEmptyHint: Local manga whose directories have disappeared land here after a scan; restore the directory on disk to recover them
browse.trashPurgeHint: This permanently removes the trashed manga and its chapters from the database. Files on disk, if any, are left alone. This cannot be undone.
browse.emptyTrashHint: All trashed manga and chapters of every local instance are permanently removed from the database. Files on disk, if any, are left alone. This cannot be undone.
browse.emptyHintAdmin: Drop source packages into the server's sources folder and click "Scan sources folder", or install in one click from "Source repos"
browse.emptyHint: No sources available yet; ask an admin to install some
